resources.string: Not sent: clipboard sharing is stopped. Open clipsync to start it.
Not sent: no paired device is connected.
Not sent: this is the text last sent or received.
Not sent: text over 1 MiB is not synced.
Run this on your PC, then tap Pair with a PC and scan the code it shows.
Battery optimisation can cut the connection to your devices while the phone sleeps.
Select text, then choose Send to devices in the menu that pops up.
Run this on your PC, then point the camera at the code it shows.
That is not a clipsync pairing code.
Text copied on that device now appears in this phone\'s clipboard.
This code was already used or has expired. Run clipsync pair again for a new one.
The PC is no longer in pairing mode. Run clipsync pair again.
The PC runs an incompatible version of clipsync.
Could not reach the PC. Check that both devices are on the same network and that its firewall allows clipsync.
The connection was lost while pairing. Try again.
The PC shows its first characters, %1$s, in clipsync status.
The devices stop syncing, and both forget each other. Pair again to resume.
